_comment: Converted from: scripts/run_daily_orders.ksh — AutoSys job JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD

_mapping.PSET parameters: Databricks job parameters and widget defaults
_mapping.set -e (fail-fast): Task dependency chain — downstream tasks skip on failure

name: daily_orders_pipeline
description: Daily orders pipeline — extract → CDC → staging → production. Migrated from Ab Initio KornShell orchestration (run_daily_orders.ksh) triggered by AutoSys job JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD.

schedule._comment: Original: AutoSys JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD — daily batch schedule

new_cluster._comment: 4 workers maps to Ab Initio AI_DEFAULT_PARTITIONS=4 from setenv.ksh

parameters.name: batch_date
parameters._comment: Maps to BATCH_DATE=$(date +%Y-%%m-%%d) in KornShell script. Empty = today.

parameters.name: partition_count
parameters._comment: Maps to -partition 4 in Phase 2 CDC air sandbox run command

parameters.name: max_errors
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET MAX_ERRORS=100 from orders_pipeline.pset

parameters.name: source_path
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET SOURCE_PATH from orders_pipeline.pset

parameters.name: target_table
parameters._comment: Maps to PSET TARGET_TABLE from orders_pipeline.pset

tasks._comment: Phase 1 from KornShell: air sandbox run extract_orders.mp -pset orders_extract.pset
tasks.description: Phase 1: Extract from source systems. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/extract_orders.mp

tasks._comment: Phase 2 from KornShell: air sandbox run cdc_orders.mp -pset orders_cdc.pset -partition 4
tasks.description: Phase 2: CDC detection. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/cdc_orders.mp with -partition 4

tasks._comment: Phase 3 from KornShell: air sandbox run load_staging_orders.mp -pset orders_staging.pset
tasks.description: Phase 3: Load to staging. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/load_staging_orders.mp

tasks._comment: Phase 4 from KornShell: air sandbox run prod_rollover_orders.mp -pset orders_prod.pset
tasks.description: Phase 4: Production rollover. Replaces: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/prod_rollover_orders.mp

email_notifications._comment: Replaces Ab Initio exit code checks + AutoSys failure alerting

_comment_max_concurrent: Equivalent to AutoSys job exclusion — only one daily run at a time
